assets.author: Eloria project
assets.description: Original Nymara creatures authored to production anatomy from the supplied Eloria concept art: thirty-two quadrupeds plus a further one hundred and forty covering every distinct design across the sixteen concept sheets, one of which (the Verdant Crown King) is authored to its name rather than measured from a figure and is marked as such, across eight skeleton families, with smooth multi-bone skinning, procedurally generated full-colour albedo and tangent-space normal maps across twenty-six surface kinds, per-creature humanoid equipment, and original idle, walk, jog, combat, attack, hit and death clips. A subsequent fidelity pass added the geometry the artwork requires and the generators could not express: forking branch systems and strand-woven trunks for the treants and dryads, coiling ribbons for the wisps and krakens, flat-faceted shells over a lit interior for the crystal fauna, overlapping masonry plating and banded trim for the golems and constructs, layered flight feathers for the birds, and shaped faces, open cowls and flared robes for the humanoids, on a sixth material slot carrying whatever is lit from inside. Palettes, silhouette proportions, surface-growth placement, foliage colour, core-glow colour and albedo value range are all measured from the supplied concept figures rather than authored by hand
